載入: 我指派你負責她的案子，因為我知道你無法專注在其他事情上。

Restore: Marie's case number is 199144.
載入: Marie 的案號是 199144。

Restore: You might want to review another stabbing case to see if there are any similarities.
載入: 你可能想檢查另一起刺殺案件，看看有沒有類似的地方。

Restore: That case number is 199137.
載入: 那個案號是 199137。

Restore: By the way, I want to introduce you to your new partner.
載入: 對了，我想介紹你給你的新搭檔認識。

Restore: Officer Bonds, meet Officer Pat Morales, your new partner.
載入: 警員 Bonds，認識一下警員 Pat Morales，你的新搭檔。

Restore: Oh no, not you!?
載入: 噢不，不會是你吧！？

Restore: Hey, Bonds. Looks like we're stuck together, eh?
載入: 嘿，Bonds。看來我們要湊在一起了，是吧？

Restore: Sorry if I've been a little rough around the edges lately. I'm not so bad once you get to know me.
載入: 如果我最近有點粗魯的話抱歉。一旦你認識我，就知道我不是那麼壞。

Restore: Listen, Sonny. I...I can't begin to imagine what you must be going through. But I want you to know that the entire department is pulling for you to catch the thug who did this.
載入: 聽著，Sonny。我...我無法想像你現在經歷的是什麼。但我要讓你知道，整個警局都支持你抓住那個幹這事的王八蛋。

Restore: I admire your ability to maintain a professional attitude through this hardship. You are to be commended. I just wanted to remind you to examine the scene of the crime thoroughly.
載入: 我很欣賞你在這種困頓中仍能保持專業態度。這值得表揚。我只想提醒你要徹底檢查犯罪現場。

Restore: Have you been back to the mall to look for any physical evidence in Marie's stabbing yet?
載入: 你有回過購物中心找 Marie 遭刺案的物證嗎？

Restore: Bonds, don't let your emotional state over Marie's injuries distract you from making a comprehensive sweep of the crime site.
載入: Bonds，別讓你對 Marie 傷勢的情緒分散你的注意力，你要全面搜索犯罪現場。

Restore: Bonds, I understand you're getting sloppy on this case. Get your butt back to the mall and search that crime area again, damnit!
載入: Bonds，我聽說你在這案子上工作有點馬虎。滾回購物中心去，再搜一遍犯罪現場，該死！

Restore: Don't worry, your lady will pull through.
載入: 別擔心，你的妻子會挺過來的。

Restore: I hope Marie's doin' better.
載入: 我希望 Marie 好些了。

Restore: Marie's gotta be one tough cookie to have put up with you this long, Sonny. She'll be alright.
載入: Marie 一定是個硬骨頭，居然能忍受你這麼久，Sonny。她會沒事的。

Restore: Major drag about Marie, Sonny. Hope she pulls through.
載入: 關於 Marie 的事真是太糟了，Sonny。希望她能挺過來。

Restore: Well Bonds! Get out there and catch some bad guys!.
載入: 好吧，Bonds！出去抓壞傢伙吧！

Restore: You advise the captain of the pentagram pattern based on the murder locations, times, and dates.
載入: 你根據兇殺案的地點、時間和日期向警監報告五角星圖案。

Restore: You also tell him the possible location of the next hit.
載入: 你也告訴他下一次襲擊可能發生的地點。

Restore: Well that doesn't leave much you time, Bonds!
載入: 那樣的話你沒有太多時間了，Bonds！

Restore: Did you check your computer Bonds? Better take a look!
載入: 你有檢查你的電腦嗎，Bonds？最好看一下！

Restore: You seen the messages on your computer, Bonds? Better take a look!
載入: 你有看過你電腦上的訊息嗎，Bonds？最好看一下！

Restore: Have you called dispatch with that description yet?
載入: 你有把那個描述報給勤務中心嗎？

Restore: You may want to get that description on the air.
載入: 你最好把那個描述傳出去。

Restore: Well that doesn't leave much time Bonds!
載入: 這樣的話你沒有太多時間了，Bonds！

Restore: You seen the messages on your computer Bonds? Better take a look!
載入: 你有看過你電腦上的訊息嗎，Bonds？最好看一下！

Restore: Bonds! I want you to get over to the 200 block of River Road, now!
載入: Bonds！我要你馬上去 River Road 200 號街區！

Restore: You feel a warm flushed feeling comes over you as Morales walks in and catches you in her drawer.
載入: 當 Morales 走進來抓住你翻她的抽屜時，你感到一股溫暖的臉紅感。

Restore: HEY! You mind telling me what the hell you're doing in my desk? That's breaking and entering. Your going to hang for this, Bonds!
載入: 嘿！你來告訴我你在我的桌子裡幹什麼呢？這是撬鎖入室。你會為此付出代價的，Bonds！

Restore: Hey Bonds, you better quit leaving department equipment lying around. That baglady had a fit not being able to move her shopping cart.
載入: 嘿，Bonds，你最好別在那裡亂丟警局設備。那個拾荒婦女因為搬不了她的購物車而發火。

Restore: You turn bright red as the captain hands back your cuffs you forgot at the warehouse.
載入: 當警監把你在倉庫遺忘的手銬還給你時，你的臉變得通紅。

Restore: Bonds, the coroner called and said he has something important for you.
載入: Bonds，法醫打來說他有重要的事要給你。

Restore: Something he found on the fatal crash victim last night. Better get over to see him,.. pronto!
載入: 他在昨晚那個致命車禍死者身上發現的東西。最好趕快去見他！

Restore: Your partner should be back from her physical testing any second.
載入: 你的搭檔應該馬上就會從體能測試回來。

Restore: Captain, I have reason to believe that my partner, Morales, has stolen some of the evidence from the Rocklin case.   There were five bags of cocaine removed from accident scene, but only four were checked in as evidence.
載入: 警監，我有理由相信我的搭檔 Morales 從 Rocklin 案中盜竊了一些證物。   事故現場移出了五袋可卡因，但只有四袋被登錄為證物。

Restore: I'm also beginning to suspect that she may be in league with this cult.
載入: 我還開始懷疑她可能與這個教派有勾結。

Restore: Alright Bonds, I'll have the Internal Affairs boys check it out and keep an eye on her. Play it straight but be careful.
載入: 好的，Bonds，我會讓內務組去查這件事並監視她。照規矩辦但要小心。

Restore: You're not in the homicide division.
載入: 你不在重案組。

Restore: You have messages on your computer.
載入: 你電腦上有訊息。

Restore: This is your computer.
載入: 這是你的電腦。

Restore: The chairs are for officers assigned to Homicide.
載入: 這些椅子是給重案組的警員用的。

Restore: Your chair isn't exactly a lazy boy, but you like it.
載入: 你的椅子不是豪華躺椅，但你喜歡它。

Restore: You are already sitting down.
載入: 你已經坐下了。

Restore: That's where Pat sits.
載入: 那是 Pat 坐的地方。

Restore: Sit in your own chair, Sonny.
載入: 坐在你自己的椅子上，Sonny。

Restore: It's Pat's desk drawer.
載入: 那是 Pat 的桌子抽屜。

Restore: The desks are for officers assigned to Homicide.
載入: 這些桌子是給重案組的警員用的。

Restore: It's locked.
載入: 它被鎖上了。

Restore: You don't have the key.
載入: 你沒有鑰匙。

Restore: Better not while people are in the room.
載入: 最好別在有人在房間裡的時候做。

Restore: You find a piece of paper with a series of numbers on it..."386."
載入: 你發現一張紙上有一列數字…「386」。

Restore: Carefully you close and relock the drawer.
載入: 你小心地關上並重新鎖上抽屜。

Restore: You jot the numbers down in your notebook.
載入: 你把那些數字記在筆記本上。

Restore: Pat is busy at her desk right now.
載入: Pat 現在正在她的桌前忙著。

Restore: She doesn't want to shake hands, Bonds.
載入: 她不想和你握手，Bonds。

Restore: You've already informed the captain of Morales' activities.
載入: 你已經把 Morales 的活動告訴了警監。

Restore: The captain doesn't have time for idle chit chat.
載入: 警監沒有閒工夫閒聊。

Restore: You have a phone message from the captain in your basket.
載入: 你的籃子裡有來自警監的電話訊息。

Restore: There is a note in your basket.
載入: 你的籃子裡有張便條。

Restore: There's a subpoena in your basket.
載入: 你的籃子裡有份傳票。

Restore: You need your Computer Access card.
載入: 你需要你的電腦存取卡。

Restore: That's where Earl sits.
載入: 那是 Earl 坐的地方。

Restore: Messing with Captain Tate could get you fired, Bonds.
載入: 招惹 Captain Tate 可能會讓你被開除，Bonds。

Restore: That desk belongs to Pat Morales - your partner.
載入: 那張桌子是 Pat Morales 的──你的搭檔。

Restore: You are not assigned to Homicide right now.
載入: 你現在沒被分配到重案組。

Restore: There's nothing of interest on Pat's desk.
載入: Pat 的桌子上沒有什麼有趣的東西。

Restore: Earl Hank's desk is cluttered and covered with scuff marks from his shoes.
載入: Earl Hank 的桌子很亂，到處是他鞋子留下的刮痕。

Restore: Leave Earl's stuff alone.
載入: 別動 Earl 的東西。

Restore: Your desk is near the filing cabinet.
載入: 你的辦公桌在檔案櫃旁邊。

Restore: The window doesn't open and the blinds are fine.
載入: 窗戶打不開，百葉窗也好好的。

Restore: You can't stop crime by ripping up the graph.
載入: 把圖表撕了也阻止不了犯罪。

Restore: None of the books interest you.
載入: 這些書你一本都不感興趣。

Restore: The messages are public - leave them up.
載入: 這些公告是給大家看的，別拿下來。

Restore: The memo advises of a mandatory attendance of all female officers for physical performance testing at the beginning of shift tomorrow.
載入: 備忘錄通知：全體女警明天上班一開始要強制參加體能測驗。

Restore: Herein lies the names of the programmers who without undo fanfare brought you this game. Doug Oldfield, Chris Hoyt, Kim Bowdish and Mike Larsen.
載入: 這裡列著默默無聞、為你帶來這款遊戲的程式設計師名單：Doug Oldfield、Chris Hoyt、Kim Bowdish 與 Mike Larsen。

Restore: Rarely do you find anything of interest on the bulletin board.
載入: 佈告欄上很少有什麼值得看的東西。

Restore: Your fellow officers have been a little on edge since the corner donut shop closed. You take their ribbing in stride knowing that it comes with the territory when your the new Sarge on the block.
載入: 自從街角的甜甜圈店關門後，同事們的脾氣都有點浮躁。你不當一回事，畢竟剛當上新警佐，被虧幾句是免不了的。

Restore: Come on Sarge! Get with the briefing.
載入: 拜託，警佐！快點開始交班簡報吧。

Restore: The Lytton public needs us, Sergeant! Give us the crap of the day so we can get out of here.
載入: Lytton 的市民需要我們，警佐！趕快把今天的鳥事講一講，讓我們出去辦事。

Restore: You'd think a new Sergeant would know what to do.
載入: 你以為新警佐會知道該怎麼做。

Restore: Obviously the Sergeant needs someone to take him by the hand!
載入: 看來這位警佐需要有人牽著他的手才行！

Restore: Since you're obviously not up to it, the "Officer in Charge" conducts the briefing.
載入: 既然你顯然應付不來，就由「代理主管警員」來主持簡報。

Restore: Good afternoon, Officers!
載入: 各位警員，午安！

Restore: Ahem! Since Sergeant Bonds here has obviously forgotten about filling in for Officer Jaco while he's on vacation,... I will go ahead with the briefing.
載入: 咳！既然 Bonds 警佐顯然忘了自己要代理休假中的 Jaco 警員……那就由我來主持這場簡報。

Restore: Anyway, you all have today's duty sheets...
載入: 總之，各位都拿到今天的勤務表了……

Restore: Officer Miller goes over the duty sheets. Then he says...
載入: Miller 警員把勤務表講過一遍，接著說……

Restore: That's it. Have a safe shift and think about making right hand approaches on your car stops.
載入: 就這樣。祝大家勤務平安，攔車臨檢時記得從右側接近。

Restore: You begin the briefing...
載入: 你開始主持簡報……

Restore: Good afternoon, people!
載入: 各位，午安！

Restore: I will be filling in for Sergeant Jaco while he's on vacation.
載入: Jaco 警佐休假期間，由我代理。

Restore: You advise the afternoon shift of the procedural information and announcements listed on the clipboard and close by saying...
載入: 你把寫字板上的程序事項與公告一一交代給下午班，最後說……

Restore: Have a safe shift and think about making right hand approaches on your car stops.
載入: 祝大家勤務平安，攔車臨檢時記得從右側接近。

Restore: OK!  OK!  Your office after the briefing.  I heard ya!  Sheesh!
載入: 好啦！好啦！簡報完再去你辦公室，我聽到了啦！唉唷！

Restore: Morales, I need to have a word with you in my office after this afternoon's briefing.
載入: Morales，下午簡報結束後，到我辦公室來，我有話跟你說。

Restore: She REALLY doesn't want to talk to you.
載入: 她真的一點都不想跟你講話。

Restore: Afternoon, Morales.
載入: 午安，Morales。

Restore: Ok,..so what did I do this time?  Wait!... don't tell me... another complaint from some moron who thinks he was the victim of police brutality.
載入: 好啊……這次我又做了什麼？等等……別告訴我……又是哪個白痴自以為被警察施暴，跑來投訴。

Restore: Sure, Sarge. I'd love to come hear some idiot's complaint. It'd make my day.
載入: 好啊，警佐。我超想去聽哪個白痴投訴，聽了保證心情大好。

Restore: What is this, a talk show? Just give the damn briefing.
載入: 這是在幹嘛，開脫口秀嗎？簡報講一講就好。

Restore: You stutter for a moment then mutter something about just being friendly.
載入: 你結巴了一下，含糊地說自己只是想表示友善。

Restore: Officer Joe Banks responds after being interrupted from his report writing...
載入: Joe Banks 警員寫報告被打斷，回話說……

Restore: Gee Sarge, I'd really like to finish this report.
載入: 唉，警佐，我很想把這份報告寫完。

Restore: Not looking up, Officer Banks says...
載入: Banks 警員頭也不抬地說……

Restore: Please don't break my concentration!
載入: 拜託別打斷我的專注！

Restore: Officer Banks ignores you and continues writing.
載入: Banks 警員沒理你，繼續寫他的。

Restore: Referring to the academy, Carl says...
載入: Carl 提到警校時說……

Restore: Drawing attention to you, Officer Law says...
載入: Law 警員把大家的目光引到你身上，說……

Restore: Welcome back from the Palace of Pain!
載入: 歡迎從「痛苦殿堂」回來！

Restore: No doubt the Academy hasn't changed any since the crap keeps rolling down hill!
載入: 難怪警校都沒變，鳥事還是一路往下滾！

Restore: Looky here guys and gals, another star is born! We have a new Sergeant.
載入: 各位兄弟姐妹，看看這裡，又一顆新星誕生了！我們多了一位新警佐。

Restore: I bet the metamorphosis from good guy to Sergeant was a real experience.  Ha! Ha!
載入: 我打賭從好人變成警佐這段蛻變，肯定很有意思。哈！哈！

Restore: Can we get on with the briefing Sarge? I've got a date with a coffee shop!
載入: 警佐，簡報可以繼續了嗎？我跟咖啡店有約呢！

Restore: Hey Sarge! The glare coming off your new chevrons is blinding us. The department's gonna hafta' issue us sun glasses. HA!
載入: 嘿，警佐！你那新警階章亮得快把我們閃瞎了，局裡大概得發太陽眼鏡給我們了。哈！

Restore: I got a card from Sergeant Jaco. He says he's having a great time in the Bahamas - the scum.
載入: 我收到 Jaco 警佐寄來的明信片，他說他在巴哈馬玩得可樂了——這個混蛋。

Restore: Hands off, Bonds!
載入: 「手拿開，Bonds！」

Restore: Sonny Bonds wouldn't do that in a million years.
載入: Sonny Bonds 打死也不會做這種事。

Restore: They KNOW who you are, Bonds.
載入: 他們可清楚你是誰，Bonds。

Restore: This afternoon's briefing is already concluded.
載入: 今天下午的簡報已經結束了。

Restore: Not a chance.
載入: 想都別想。

Restore: Surely you can think of better ways to handle a woman - even an arrogant one!
載入: 你應該想得出更好的方法對付女人吧——就算她再囂張也一樣！

Restore: You don't need to sit down.
載入: 你不需要坐下。

Restore: Just walk out.
載入: 直接走出去就好。

Restore: Sorry, no chalk.
載入: 抱歉，沒有粉筆。

Restore: You can't give the briefing that way.
載入: 你不能用這種方式做簡報。

Restore: Those postings need to stay up for public consumption.
載入: 這些公告要留著讓大家看。

Restore: Just as you reach for the file...
載入: 就在你伸手去拿檔案的時候……

Restore: Hey! That's highly confidential material, Sergeant!
載入: 嘿！那是高度機密的資料，警佐！

Restore: While you turn bright red, Dr. Aimes asks...
載入: 你臉紅到不行的時候，Aimes 醫生問……

Restore: What is it that you WANT, Bonds? I'm a very busy man.
載入: 你到底要什麼，Bonds？我可是很忙的。

Restore: You hand the military record to the doctor.
載入: 你把軍中紀錄交給醫生。

Restore: Lovely. I get to peer into the mind of yet another scumbag.
載入: 太好了，我又能窺探另一個人渣的內心了。

Restore: The doctor reads Bains' military record.
載入: 醫生翻閱 Bains 的軍中紀錄。

Restore: Then goes into his 'analysis' pose.
載入: 接著擺出他的「分析」架勢。

Restore: Rather interesting, actually.
載入: 其實還滿有意思的。

Restore: He briefs you on the character of Michael Bains.
載入: 他向你說明 Michael Bains 的性格分析。

Restore: This guy's not your average scumbag. He's closer to the slit-his-own-mother's-throat variety.
載入: 這傢伙不是普通的人渣，他比較接近會割自己親媽喉嚨那種。

Restore: I'd know more if I'd examined him, but based on this, I'd say he's a schizophrenic psychopath.
載入: 要是我親自診察過他會知道更多，但就這份資料來看，我認為他是個思覺失調的精神病態者。

Restore: This guy's criminally insane, Bonds. I'd be careful how I approached him.
載入: 這傢伙有刑事精神異常，Bonds。我要是你，接近他時會非常小心。

Restore: I told you, I can't diagnose thin air.
載入: 我說過了，我沒辦法對著空氣做診斷。

Restore: Excuse me, Dr. Aimes, I'm tracking a suspected serial killer.
載入: 不好意思，Aimes 醫生，我正在追查一名連續殺人案的嫌犯。

Restore: Think you can help me out by putting together a psychological profile on him?
載入: 你能不能幫我做一份他的心理側寫？

Restore: Where's your documentation? I can't diagnose thin air.
載入: 你的資料在哪裡？我沒辦法對著空氣做診斷。

Restore: You try striking up a conversation with Doctor Sidney Aimes.
載入: 你試著跟 Sidney Aimes 醫生攀談。

Restore: If you haven't got anything useful to show me, Bonds, please leave. I've no time for chit chat.
載入: 如果你沒有拿得出手的資料給我看，Bonds，請你離開，我沒時間閒聊。

Restore: I said, keep your hands off, Sergeant! Are you deaf?
載入: 我說了，手拿開，警佐！你是聾了嗎？

Restore: Would you mind not playing with my balls, please?
載入: 可以請你別碰我的球嗎？

Restore: Well, Bonds?  You've got your information, now go and catch him.
載入: 怎樣，Bonds？你已經拿到資料了，還不快去抓他。

Restore: Now that IS Freudian.
載入: 這下真的是佛洛伊德式的了。

Restore: He's already seen the military record.
載入: 他已經看過軍中紀錄了。

Restore: But... you're not a mindless executive.
載入: 但是……你又不是個沒頭腦的主管。

Restore: If you want to play psychologist, you bought the wrong game.
載入: 如果你想扮心理醫生，那你買錯遊戲了。

載入: 你跳上救護車，鳴笛全速趕往醫院。

Restore: Marie is rushed to Lytton General Emergency where doctors begin the race to save her life.
載入: Marie 被緊急送往 Lytton 綜合醫院急診室，醫生們立刻展開搶救。

Restore: They work through the night, fighting to stabilize Marie's condition. Sonny spends hours of agony in the waiting room. Although they manage to save her life, Marie remains in a coma.
載入: 他們徹夜搶救，設法穩住 Marie 的狀況。Sonny 在候診室裡煎熬了好幾個鐘頭。雖然保住了她的性命，Marie 卻陷入昏迷。

Restore: When he's finally allowed to see her, Sonny holds her hand until the pre-dawn hours, hoping and searching for some sign that she'll come back to him.
載入: 終於獲准進去探視後，Sonny 一直握著她的手直到破曉前，盼望能看見她甦醒的徵兆。

Restore: Physically and emotionally exhausted, you decide to go home and get some rest.
載入: 身心俱疲的你，決定回家休息一下。

Restore: Looks like another one bit the dust, eh?
載入: 看來又掛了一個，是吧？

Restore: I understand you were here before they removed the victim. Did you catch any dying words? Notice any signs of sexual assault? Anything at all?
載入: 我聽說被害人被抬走之前你就在場。她有沒有留下遺言？有沒有性侵的跡象？隨便什麼線索都好？

Restore: Responding to your silence, the reporter says...
載入: 面對你的沉默，這名記者接著說……

Restore: Well, if YOU don't want to talk to me, I'll just get the information elsewhere!
載入: 好啊，你不肯跟我說，那我自己去別的地方打聽！

Restore: Listen, you little blood sucking piece of FILTH! The victim was my wife! You guys are all the same. Now get outta here before I forget that I'm wearing this badge!
載入: 聽好了，你這個吸血的人渣！被害人是我老婆！你們這種人都一個樣。趁我還記得自己戴著這面警徽，滾出去！

Restore: I'll give your paper some details alright!... All about how I rearranged your face!
載入: 我這就給你的報社一些細節……講講我是怎麼把你的臉重新排列的！

Restore: Oh, Geez! Look Officer I- I'm terribly sorry!
載入: 天啊！聽著，警官，我……我真的很抱歉！

Restore: I'm just trying to get the facts. I thought you cops liked that kind of loose talk - helps keep things from getting too serious, know what I mean?
載入: 我只是想弄清楚事實。我還以為你們警察喜歡那種嘴上開開玩笑，讓場面不要太沉重，你懂我的意思吧？

Restore: Here's my card. If there is anything I can ever help you with, Officer, give me a ring, huh? Again, sorry about your wife.
載入: 這是我的名片。以後有什麼需要幫忙的，警官，打給我，好嗎？還有，你太太的事，我很遺憾。

Restore: You feel a moment of remorse for your outburst, and almost say 'thanks', but fortunately the moment passes.
載入: 你為自己剛才的失控感到一絲愧疚，差點就脫口說出「謝謝」，幸好那股衝動很快就過去了。

Restore: The officer is intent on his search and ignores you.
載入: 那名警員專注在搜查上，沒理會你。

Restore: Your batteries appear to be dead.
載入: 你的電池似乎沒電了。

Restore: You catch the glint of an object lying just beneath Marie's car.
載入: 你瞥見 Marie 的車底下有個東西閃著光。

Restore: You pick up what appears to be a medallion. Upon closer inspection you recognize it to be a "Bronze Star" war medal.
載入: 你撿起一個看似勳章的東西。仔細一看，你認出那是一枚「銅星勳章」。

Restore: It's a very LARGE streetlamp.
載入: 這是一盞非常大的路燈。

Restore: You try to search the area, but it's just too dark to see anything. Perhaps you should come back when it's light.
載入: 你試著搜查這一帶，但天色太暗什麼也看不清。或許等天亮再回來比較好。

Restore: The parking lot blacktop.
載入: 停車場的柏油地面。

Restore: Some of the mall's stores are undergoing renovation.
載入: 這座購物中心有幾家店正在整修。

Restore: That store is closed.
載入: 那家店已經打烊了。

Restore: Sidewalks connect the store fronts.
載入: 人行道連接著各家店面。

Restore: The flashlight is already on.
載入: 手電筒已經是開著的。

Restore: That's the Army Recruiter's office.
載入: 那是陸軍徵兵處。

Restore: The Army Recruiter's office is closed for the night.
載入: 陸軍徵兵處今晚已經打烊了。

Restore: That's the shop of "Zak" the keymaker.
載入: 那是鎖匠「Zak」的店。

Restore: Zak's key shop is closed for the night.
載入: Zak 的鑰匙店今晚已經打烊了。

Restore: Marie's Trans Am still sits in the poorly lit parking lot of the mall. You scan the car for clues... but find nothing.
載入: Marie 的 Trans Am 仍停在購物中心那燈光昏暗的停車場裡。你仔細檢查車子想找線索……但一無所獲。

Restore: What can I do for you?
載入: 有什麼我能幫你的？

Restore: Need a key made?
載入: 要配鑰匙嗎？

Restore: I make keys for big locks, small locks, clocks, cars, tanks and banks. What do you need fella?
載入: 大鎖小鎖、時鐘、汽車、坦克、銀行的鑰匙我都配。老兄，你要什麼？

Restore: What, you want another one? You got a family of ten moving in or what?
載入: 怎麼，你還要一把？你家是搬來十口人喔？

Restore: Ah yes! No problem with this little jewel. I'll have a copy in a second.
載入: 啊，好！這個小寶貝沒問題。馬上就給你配好。

Restore: Sorry, but this key says "Do Not Duplicate."
載入: 抱歉，這把鑰匙上寫著「禁止複製」。

Restore: Here you are fella, that'll be two fifty.
載入: 拿去吧老兄，兩塊五。

Restore: You give Zak his two dollars and fifty cents.
載入: 你付給 Zak 兩塊五毛錢。

Restore: Thanks buddy... Another day another two dollars and fifty cents.
載入: 謝啦老兄……又是平凡的一天，又賺了兩塊五。

Restore: You what? No money? Do I look like an idiot to you? Get outta my shop!
載入: 你說什麼？沒錢？你當我是白痴嗎？滾出我的店！

Restore: Sorry, this key says 'Do Not Duplicate' on it.
載入: 抱歉，這把鑰匙上寫著「禁止複製」。

Restore: What do you want me to do with that?  I'm a KEY maker, for crying out loud.
載入: 你要我拿這個怎麼辦？我是配鑰匙的，老天爺啊。

Restore: Just giving away money, Sonny?
載入: 錢多到花不完喔，Sonny？

Restore: You don't have the correct change.
載入: 你身上沒有剛好的零錢。

Restore: Morales is making a phone call.
載入: Morales 正在講電話。

Restore: That's Officer Pat Morales, your partner.
載入: 那是 Pat Morales 警員，你的搭檔。

Restore: You retrieve the bronze star.
載入: 你取回了那枚銅星勳章。

Restore: OH NO! you think... "This just can't be!!  Not Marie!"
載入: 「不！」你心想……「這不可能！不會是 Marie！」

Restore: What's wrong with her!
載入: 她怎麼了！

Restore: Multiple stab wounds.  Damage unclear.
載入: 多處刺傷，傷勢尚不明。

Restore: It doesn't look good.  We have to get her to the hospital STAT.
載入: 情況不樂觀，我們得立刻送她去醫院！

Restore: We're ready.  If you're goin', you'd better climb in, Officer.
載入: 我們準備好了。你要一起去的話，最好趕快上車，警官。

Restore: You see something clutched in Marie's hand.
載入: 你看見 Marie 手裡緊握著什麼東西。

Restore: It's empty.
載入: 裡面是空的。

Restore: You remove what appears to be a chain from Marie's hand.
載入: 你從 Marie 手中取出一條鍊子。

Restore: Looking at the broken chain you think... "Marie must have pulled this from the attacker's neck!"
載入: 看著這條斷掉的鍊子，你心想……「Marie 一定是從攻擊者脖子上扯下這個的！」

Restore: And you ponder the thought... "I just wonder if something else was on this chain."
載入: 你不禁思忖……「不知道這條鍊子上原本是不是還掛著別的東西。」

Restore: Her hand feels cold.
載入: 她的手感覺冰冷。

Restore: You try waking her, but she doesn't respond.
載入: 你試著叫醒她，但她毫無反應。

Restore: You drop your partner off at the station then drive yourself home for some needed rest.
載入: 你把搭檔送回警局後，自己開車回家好好休息。

Restore: Feeling physically and emotionally drained, you drive home.
載入: 感到身心俱疲的你，開車回家。

Restore: Officer Bonds, I'm Dr. Wagner, the resident neurosurgeon.
載入: Bonds 警官，我是 Wagner 醫師，這裡的住院神經外科醫師。

Restore: I'm sorry to say that your wife's condition is still quite serious.  She's suffering from internal injuries sustained from the multiple stab wounds.
載入: 很遺憾，你太太的狀況仍然相當嚴重。她因為多處刺傷而有內臟損傷。

Restore: How long she will remain in a coma is anyone's guess.
載入: 她會昏迷多久，誰也說不準。

Restore: In my experience, the presence of a loved one urging the patient back from that void is an incalculable asset.
載入: 依我的經驗，親人在旁呼喚，勸病人從那片虛無中回來，是一種難以估量的幫助。

Restore: We're doing all we can for her physically, but you might be the only one who can reach her now.
載入: 我們在醫療上已經盡了全力，但現在或許只有你才能喚得回她。

Restore: The nurse found this chain clutched in your wife's hand.
載入: 護理師在你太太手中發現了這條鍊子。

Restore: Sergeant Bonds, you look beat.  You really should go home and try to get some rest.  There's nothing to be done for your wife right now.
載入: Bonds 警佐，你看起來累壞了。你真的該回家休息一下。現在你太太這邊也沒什麼你能做的了。

Restore: We can all feel good about the fact that Marie is alive.
載入: Marie 還活著，這一點就值得我們慶幸了。

Restore: Marie!  Please come back, Baby.  I can't go on without you.
載入: Marie！求求妳醒過來，寶貝。沒有妳我活不下去。

Restore: You fight to pull yourself together.
載入: 你強忍情緒，努力讓自己振作起來。

Restore: I...I've gotta go now, Babe.  You need your rest.  It's been a rough night.
載入: 我……我得先走了，寶貝。妳需要休息。今晚真的很難熬。

Restore: I'll get the bastard who did this, Babe.  I SWEAR IT!
載入: 我會抓到做這件事的混蛋，寶貝。我發誓！

Restore: As a fellow officer drives you back to your car at the mall, you fight to focus your rage, grief, and sense of violation into something you can live with.
載入: 一名同僚開車送你回購物中心取車，你努力把滿腔的憤怒、悲傷與屈辱感，收攏成自己能承受的樣子。

Restore: What you end up with is a burning desire to find and crucify the slime that hurt your wife.
載入: 最後剩下的，是一股想找出並嚴懲那個傷害你太太的人渣的熊熊怒火。

Restore: Somebody out there picked the wrong man to mess with.
載入: 外頭有個傢伙，這次是惹錯人了。

Restore: The chart shows that Marie's IV dosage is supposed to be set at 0.005
載入: 病歷表上顯示，Marie 的點滴劑量應該設定在 0.005。

Restore: You gently kiss Marie's lips.
載入: 你輕輕吻了 Marie 的嘴唇。

Restore: Sweet dreams!
載入: 祝妳好夢！

Restore: You softly kiss your wife.  Her eyelids flicker in response.
載入: 你輕柔地吻了太太一下。她的眼皮微微顫動，像是有了回應。

Restore: Doctor Wagner's face is grave as he says...
載入: Wagner 醫師神情凝重地說……

Restore: I'm afraid I don't have any good news, Sonny.   Marie's condition is unchanged.
載入: 恐怕我沒有什麼好消息，Sonny。Marie 的狀況沒有改變。

Restore: There's nothing more we can do but wait... and hope.
載入: 我們現在能做的，只剩下等待……和盼望。

Restore: Again, I'm sorry, Officer.  Now if you'll excuse me, I have other patients to attend to.
載入: 再說一次，我很遺憾，警官。容我先失陪了，還有其他病人等著我。

Restore: She seems to be resting quietly now.
載入: 她現在似乎正安靜地休息著。

Restore: Hello, Sergeant Bonds.  I'm afraid there's no change.
載入: 你好，Bonds 警佐。恐怕還是沒有變化。

Restore: Nothing new to report, I'm afraid.
載入: 恐怕沒有新的消息可以回報。

Restore: We haven't noticed any changes, but I think she appreciates you being here, just the same.
載入: 我們沒有注意到什麼變化，不過我想她還是很感謝你在這裡陪著她。

Restore: In an anxious voice, you tell the nurse you're concerned about the IV dosage.
載入: 你語帶焦急地向護理師表示，你對點滴的劑量感到擔心。

Restore: I'll get the doctor to check on that right away, Officer.
載入: 我馬上請醫師來檢查一下，警官。

Restore: Torn between feeling foolish and genuinely alarmed, you explain to the doctor that there seems to be a discrepancy between the IV dosage on the chart and that on the IV meter.
載入: 你一邊覺得自己是不是太多心，一邊又真的感到不安，向醫師解釋病歷表上的點滴劑量和點滴計上顯示的似乎對不上。

Restore: The doctor looks doubtful as he checks the chart...
載入: 醫師一臉狐疑地翻看病歷表……

Restore: ...Then the IV.
載入: ……接著又看了看點滴。

Restore: With a red face, the doctor says...
載入: 醫師漲紅了臉說……

Restore: Why...You're correct, Sergeant Bonds.   This dosage is obviously incorrect.
載入: 這……你說得沒錯，Bonds 警佐。這個劑量顯然不對。

Restore: I don't understand this at all.  I can't believe our staff could make such a serious error!   I have readjusted the IV.  Perhaps Marie will feel better now.
載入: 我實在不明白怎麼會這樣。真不敢相信我們的人員會犯下這麼嚴重的錯誤！我已經重新調整了點滴，Marie 現在或許會好一些。

Restore: Marie's eyelids flutter, almost as though she could hear her music box.
載入: Marie 的眼皮微微顫動，彷彿聽見了音樂盒的聲音。

Restore: You could swear that you just saw Marie's finger move!
載入: 你敢發誓，你剛才看到 Marie 的手指動了一下！

Restore: Marie's mouth moves slightly.
載入: Marie 的嘴唇微微動了一下。

Restore: Marie's eyes finally open. The warmth of her smile gives you hope for the first time since her attack.   You're a lucky man, Sonny Bonds.  Marie is alive and whole.
載入: Marie 終於睜開了眼睛。她溫暖的笑容，是她遇襲以來你第一次感受到希望。你是個幸運的男人，Sonny Bonds。Marie 活著，而且完好無缺。

Restore: Do you need something, Sergeant Bonds?
載入: 你有什麼需要嗎，Bonds 警佐？

Restore: If there is nothing else, I have to get back to work.
載入: 如果沒別的事，我得回去工作了。

Restore: I never lost hope!  I just knew that somehow, someway, you would come back to me.
載入: 我從沒放棄希望！我就是知道，不管用什麼方法，妳一定會回到我身邊。

Restore: It was your strength and your will to live that brought you back.
載入: 是妳的堅強和求生意志，把妳帶回來的。

Restore: You're going to be fine now sweetness. You'll be up and around in no time.
載入: 妳現在會沒事的，甜心。妳很快就能下床走動了。

Restore: There's no doubt in my mind, somebody up there is looking out for you.
載入: 我很確定，上天在保佑著妳。

Restore: We're real close to nailing the animals that caused this.
載入: 我們已經快抓到做這件事的畜生了。

Restore: The digital readout indicates Marie's IV dosage.
載入: 數位顯示幕上顯示著 Marie 的點滴劑量。

Restore: One moment, Sir.
載入: 請稍等，長官。

Restore: That won't help Marie come back.  They're doing all they can.
載入: 那樣做對 Marie 醒來沒有幫助。他們已經盡力了。

Restore: You've already introduced yourself to the hospital staff.
載入: 你已經向醫院的工作人員自我介紹過了。

Restore: Marie is resting gently.  You don't want to disturb her.
載入: Marie 正安穩地休息著，你不想打擾她。

Restore: You gently place a fresh rose in Marie's hand.   However, there is no response.  Nice try Sonny.
載入: 你輕輕把一朵新鮮玫瑰放進 Marie 手中，然而她毫無反應。這次沒成功，Sonny。

Restore: Marie's condition might yet be reversible.  Don't give up without a fight.
載入: Marie 的狀況或許還有機會扭轉，別輕易放棄。

Restore: You can't change the medication by yourself.
載入: 你不能自己更改藥物用量。

Restore: The room temperature is monitored carefully by the staff.   You don't need to open the window.
載入: 病房的溫度有工作人員仔細控管，你不需要開窗。

Restore: Marie lies awake in the bed.
載入: Marie 醒著躺在床上。

Restore: Marie lies motionless on the hospital bed.
載入: Marie 一動也不動地躺在病床上。

Restore: The hospital bed does not need adjustment.
載入: 醫院病床不需要調整。

Restore: Words cannot discribe the joy you feel seeing Marie awake from her coma.
載入: 你看到 Marie 從昏迷中甦醒，心中的喜悅難以言喻。

Restore: The EKG monitor registers your wife's vital signs.   Its steady beep in response to her pulse gives you some small comfort.
載入: 心電圖監視器記錄著你妻子的生命徵象。隨著她脈搏起伏的規律嗶聲，讓你稍感安心。

Restore: The Monitor's beep reminds you that although Marie is awake, she is not out of the woods yet.
載入: 監視器的嗶聲提醒你，雖然 Marie 已經醒了，但還沒脫離險境。

Restore: Leave the monitor alone.  It will alert the staff if Marie goes into distress.
載入: 別動這台監視器。萬一 Marie 有異狀，它會通知醫護人員。

Restore: You do not need the metal stand.
載入: 你不需要這個金屬架。

Restore: There's nothing in the cabinets that would be of use to you.
載入: 櫃子裡沒有你用得到的東西。

Restore: You're too upset by the sight of Marie to even think about sitting down.
載入: 看到 Marie 這個樣子，你心煩意亂，根本沒心思坐下。

Restore: You don't feel like sitting right now.
載入: 你現在沒有心情坐下。

Restore: There's no reason to draw the curtains right now.
載入: 現在沒有理由拉上窗簾。

Restore: Marie is resting gently.  You do not to disturb her.
載入: Marie 正安靜地休息，你不想打擾她。

Restore: You talk gently to your wife, hoping that some part of her hears you.
載入: 你輕聲對妻子說話，希望她多少能聽見你的聲音。

Restore: You are overjoyed to see your wife recovered.
載入: 看到妻子康復，你欣喜若狂。

Restore: Your beloved wife lies motionless in a coma.  You wish there was some way to know what she's thinking... if she's thinking.
載入: 你摯愛的妻子昏迷不醒、一動也不動。你多希望有辦法知道她在想什麼……如果她還在想事情的話。

Restore: You gently place a fresh rose in Marie's hand.   However, there is no response.
載入: 你輕輕把一朵新鮮的玫瑰放進 Marie 手中，但她毫無反應。

Restore: Marie's proud of your career as a police officer, but she's not interested in your badge right now.
載入: Marie 一直以你的警察生涯為榮，但她現在對你的警徽沒興趣。

Restore: Marie's condition might yet be reversable.  Don't give up without a fight.
載入: Marie 的狀況或許還有轉圜餘地，別輕言放棄。

Restore: You shouldn't mess with things you know nothing about.
載入: 你不該亂碰自己不懂的東西。

Restore: There's no reason to turn off the light.
載入: 沒有理由關燈。

Restore: You don't need the nurse now.
載入: 你現在不需要護士。

Restore: You press the call button and hope that the nurse is on the way.
載入: 你按下呼叫鈴，希望護士已經在路上了。

Restore: Let Marie keep her rose.
載入: 讓 Marie 留著她的玫瑰吧。

載入: 那傢伙沒有做錯什麼。

Restore: Excuse me, Sir. is that your car parked right out front?
載入: 不好意思，先生。外面停著的車是你的嗎？

Restore: Naw! My car's been in the shop all week. Why?
載入: 不是！我的車整週都在修車廠。幹嘛？

Restore: Nothing. thanks.
載入: 沒事。謝謝。

Restore: The guy's busy drowning his sorrows and doesn't pay any attention to you.
載入: 那傢伙正忙著借酒澆愁，沒在理你。

Restore: He hasn't done anything wrong. Leave him alone.
載入: 他沒有做錯什麼。別理他。

Restore: Excuse me sir, is that your car parked right out front?
載入: 不好意思，先生，外面停著的車是你的嗎？

Restore: Not me. I drive a Harley man!
載入: 不是我。我騎哈雷機車！

Restore: Sorry to bother you.
載入: 抱歉打擾了。

Restore: Touching the pool table while someone is playing isn't a good idea.
載入: 有人在玩撞球時碰撞球台不是個好主意。

Restore: If you want a drink just order one.
載入: 你要喝東西就點一杯吧。

Restore: Ahh... if you only had time!
載入: 啊...要是你有時間就好！

Restore: You don't have time to watch television.
載入: 你沒有時間看電視。

Restore: You wouldn't take one of those tacky candles if somebody paid you.
載入: 就算有人付錢你也不會拿那些俗氣的蠟燭。

Restore: No thanks, you don't smoke.
載入: 不用了，你不抽菸。

Restore: The door is locked.
載入: 門被鎖了。

Restore: You decide to drive to the hospital to check up on marie.
載入: 你決定開車去醫院看 Marie。

Restore: This is the front entrance to the coroner's office.
載入: 這是法醫辦公室的前面入口。

Restore: Your car sits out in front of the coroner's office.
載入: 你的車停在法醫辦公室的外面。

Restore: You haven't even been inside yet!
載入: 你還沒進去過！

Restore: The trunk of your car is closed.
載入: 你的車行李廂是關著的。

Restore: Since you're not a dog, I'll ignore that request.
載入: 既然你不是狗，我就忽視那個要求。

Restore: Not having a green thumb, you leave the tree alone.
載入: 沒有園藝天賦，你就別管那棵樹了。

Restore: There's nothing you can do with the sign.
載入: 你沒辦法對那個標誌做什麼。

Restore: There's nothing you can do with the sidewalk.
載入: 你沒辦法對人行道做什麼。

Restore: Ok Bonds,... Lets try and keep our mind on our work!
載入: 好的，Bonds...我們專心工作吧！

Restore: You decide to stick around until the coroner shows up.
載入: 你決定留下來等法醫出現。

Restore: Oh yeah, I almost forgot Rocklin's personal effects.
載入: 「哦是啦，我差點忘了 Rocklin 的私人物品。」

Restore: Well, if it isn't Sergeant 'B'.  I hadda hunch you might show up.
載入: 哦，如果不是警佐 B。我就猜你可能會出現。

Restore: You might find this amusing.  I found it on your dead suspect.  Looks like you have a fan.
載入: 你可能會覺得有趣。我在你那具死屍上找到它。看起來你有個粉絲。

Restore: With a sinking feeling, you recognize the old news article covering your promotion.
載入: 心下一沉，你認出了那篇報導你升職的舊新聞。

Restore: A red marking pen pentagram mars your photograph.
載入: 紅色簽字筆的五芒星毀掉了你的照片。

Restore: I wouldn't worry about it,\nBonds.  You look GOOD in red.
載入: 我不會擔心，\nBonds。你穿紅色看起來很棒。

Restore: Not to worry.  I've got a positive I.D. on your stiff.  Name's Steven Rocklin.  Last known address is 500 West Peach.
載入: 別擔心。我有你那具屍體的確切身分。叫 Steven Rocklin。最後已知地址是 West Peach 500 號。

Restore: I've got all of Rocklin's belongings in an envelope over on the counter for you.
載入: 我把 Rocklin 的所有物品放在櫃檯上的信封裡，等著你來拿。

Restore: I see you found that manilla envelope I put out for you.  The stuff in there was Rocklin's.
載入: 我看你找到了我給你留的那個牛皮信封。裡面的東西都是 Rocklin 的。

Restore: I found this under the fingernails of your murder victim, Andrew Dent.  A little skin, a little hair...   Think of it as my gift to you.
載入: 我在你那位謀殺案被害人 Andrew Dent 的指甲下面找到了這個。一點皮膚，一些頭髮……當成是我送你的禮物吧。

Restore: Hey, drop by for lunch some time!  I'll slice us up some fresh pastrami!
載入: 嘿，改天中午來吃個飯啊！我給你切點新鮮的培根肉！

Restore: Hey, Bonds... you ok?  You look a little green around the gills!
載入: 嘿，Bonds……你沒事吧？你臉色有點難看啊！

Restore: Nope.  Nobody you know.  There's a toe tag, though.
載入: 沒有。不是你認識的人。不過有驗屍編號標籤。

Restore: You notice a toe tag.
載入: 你注意到了驗屍編號標籤。

Restore: This corpse's feet look particularly unattractive.  You notice a toe tag.
載入: 這具屍體的腳看起來特別讓人不舒服。你注意到了驗屍編號標籤。

Restore: The drawers store bodies.  You wonder if there's anyone you know in there.
載入: 這些抽屜裡存放的是屍體。你心想不知道裡面有沒有認識的人。

Restore: I'm starting to worry about you Bonds.
載入: 「我開始擔心你了，Bonds。」

Restore: Leon Mandel is the County Coroner.  It's rare to see him without something or other in his mouth.  He's a little strange, but you've come to appreciate his sense of humor.
載入: Leon Mandel 是郡驗屍官。要看到他嘴裡沒有東西的時候很罕見。他有點奇怪，但你已經學會欣賞他的幽默感了。

Restore: Leon's not about to share his sandwich.
載入: Leon 不太可能分享他的三明治。

Restore: Nah.  He might enjoy it.
載入: 不會。他說不定還挺享受的。

Restore: Hey, you want a picture?  I'll send you an autographed one.  Me in my polka dot swim trunks.  No problem.
載入: 嘿，你想要張照片嗎？我可以寄給你一張簽了名的。我穿著圓點泳褲的照片。沒問題。

Restore: Whaddaya want from me, a medal?  Your evidence boys down at the station have the time and equipment for all that lab analysis stuff.  Me, I'm busy enough with just the stiffs.
載入: 你想從我這裡要什麼，一枚勳章？你們局裡的鑑識組有時間和設備做那些實驗室分析工作。我呢，光是忙著應付這些死人就夠累的了。

Restore: Better hang on to it!
載入: 最好好好保管它！

Restore: There's a large manilla envelope on the counter.
載入: 櫃檯上有一個大牛皮信封。

Restore: Knowing what a strange individual Leon is, you decide to stay out of his cabinets.
載入: 考慮到 Leon 有多古怪，你決定別去翻他的櫃子。

Restore: Leon certainly has a lot of storage space in here.
載入: Leon 這裡確實有很多儲存空間。

Restore: Even if Leon GAVE you that chart, you wouldn't take it.
載入: 即使 Leon 把那張圖表送給你，你也不會要。

Restore: You'd rather not look at that chart on the wall.  You see enough of that stuff at accident scenes.
載入: 你寧願不看牆上那張圖表。你在車禍現場看過夠多那類東西了。

Restore: You don't have much call for embalming fluid, Sergeant.
載入: 防腐液對你這位警佐用處不大。

Restore: The bottles contain embalming fluid.
載入: 這些瓶子裡裝的是防腐液。

Restore: There'll be time enough for you to be on the table when you're dead.
載入: 等你死了以後，會有充足的時間讓你上解剖台。

Restore: The sight of the cold, stainless steel autopsy table sends a chill through the spine as you recall the many times you've come close to ending up on one.
載入: 看到冷冰冰的不鏽鋼解剖台，你脊背發涼，回想起自己曾經好幾次險些躺上去。

Restore: This isn't "Life & Death".  There's a REASON you didn't go into forensics.  Just looking at those instruments makes you queasy.
載入: 這不是「生死時刻」。你沒有從事法醫工作是有原因的。光是看著那些工具就讓你感到噁心。

Restore: A number of cruel-looking stainless steel instruments lie on a towel on the counter.
載入: 一些看起來很殘酷的不鏽鋼儀器放在櫃檯上的毛巾上。

Restore: You'd better leave "Demi" alone.  You know how Leon is about his bones.
載入: 你最好別碰「Demi」。你知道 Leon 對他的骨頭有多執著。

Restore: That's Leon's 'girlfriend', Demi Bones.
載入: 那是 Leon 的「女友」，Demi Bones。

Restore: The toe tag reads "%s".
載入: 驗屍編號標籤上寫著「%s」。

Restore: Good old Leon.  He has so much fun naming the John Does.
載入: 老天啊 Leon。他給無名屍取名的時候可開心了。

Restore: The toe tag reads "%s" - the poor stiff you found in the alley.
載入: 驗屍編號標籤上寫著「%s」——你在巷子裡找到的那具可憐的屍體。

Restore: Underneath the name is a note:  "Bonds - Caught you peeking!  Stepped out for a bite.  Be back soon - Leon."
載入: 名字下面有一張紙條：「Bonds——抓到你在偷看！出去吃口東西去了。待會兒回來——Leon。」

Restore: This place does have a way of making you want to wash your hands, doesn't it?
載入: 這個地方確實有種讓人想洗手的感覺，是吧？

Restore: The Coroner's office is equipped with a sink.  You hate to think about what washes down those drains!
載入: 驗屍官辦公室裡有一個水槽。你不想去想那些排水管裡沖下去的是什麼東西！

Restore: I don't think Leon would appreciate your playing with his toys.
載入: 我不認為 Leon 會歡迎你去玩他的玩意兒。

Restore: The embalming machine is a kind of mechanical vampire.  Out with the old, in with the new...
載入: 防腐機就像某種機械吸血鬼。把舊的吸出去，把新的灌進來……

Restore: You ignore the firemen and walk right into the burning house. Falling debris hits you on the head, and you succumb to the flames.
載入: 你無視消防隊員走直進燃燒的房子裡。掉落的殘骸砸中了你的頭，你被火焰吞沒了。

Restore: I'll deal with the gawkers across the street.
載入: 我會去應付街對面那些看熱鬧的人。

Restore: Just try to conduct yourself like a professional.  OK, Morales?
載入: 試試看能不能表現得像個專業人士。好嗎，Morales？

Restore: No prob' Boss man!
載入: 沒問題，老闆！

Restore: Ok folks! Who brought the marshmallows, huh?
載入: 好吧各位！誰帶棉花糖來了，嗯？

Restore: I'll go take care of the gawkers across the street, Sonny.
載入: 我去應付街對面那些看熱鬧的人，Sonny。

Restore: What appears to have started the fire?
載入: 火看起來是怎麼起的？

Restore: Looks like arson to me. She went up awful fast.
載入: 在我看來像是縱火。火勢上來得很快。

Restore: Do you have any idea who might have started it?
載入: 你有沒有想過誰可能幹的？

Restore: It's under investigation. You can go in if you like.
載入: 正在調查中。如果你願意可以進去。

Restore: You thank the fire chief and let him get back to work.
載入: 你向消防隊長道謝，讓他回到工作崗位。

Restore: Hey you!  Get back away from the fire line!
載入: 嘿你！退到火災警戒線以外去！

Restore: Officer, I found something you might want to look at.
載入: 警官，我找到了東西，你可能想看看。

Restore: It looks like a photograph.
載入: 看起來像是一張照片。

Restore: It takes you a moment to realize what you're seeing.  You feel goosebumps crawl up your back.
載入: 你花了一陣子才意識到自己看到了什麼。你感到雞皮疙瘩爬上後背。

Restore: The man on the left is none other than your one-time arch nemesis, Jessie Bains.  The man on the right bears a striking resemblance to him.
載入: 左邊的人不是別人，正是你曾經的死對頭 Jessie Bains。右邊的人長得和他有驚人的相似。

Restore: You don't believe this!  The Bains brothers, Michael and Jessie.
載入: 你無法相信！Bains 兄弟，Michael 和 Jessie。

Restore: The firemen are struggling to put out the fire.
載入: 消防隊員正在努力撲滅大火。

Restore: The firemen are anxious to get this wrapped up.
載入: 消防隊員急著要把這場火撲滅。

Restore: The fire's under control. Not to worry.
載入: 「火勢已經控制住了。不用擔心。」

Restore:
Hey, we're off call as soon as we're done here. Who wants to grab a beer down at Johnny's?	「嘿，我們一完成就下班。誰想去 Johnny's 喝杯啤酒？
We've almost got it out now."
載入: 「我們差不多要把它撲滅了。」

Restore: Man, I gotta call my wife. Anybody seen a phone?
載入: 「天啊，我得給我老婆打個電話。有人看到電話嗎？」

Restore: This fire's nothing compared to the office building that went up yesterday.
載入: 「這場火比昨天那棟辦公樓的火小多了。」

Restore: This one didn't take long at all. At least we caught it before it spread up the street.
載入: 「這場火沒花多長時間。至少我們在它蔓延到街上之前控制住了。」

Restore: It looks like the man with the bull horn is in charge. He must be the fire chief.
載入: 看起來那個拿著擴音器的人是負責人。他應該是消防隊長。

Restore: The fire chief is focused on his men. He doesn't notice you.
載入: 消防隊長專注於他的手下。他沒有注意到你。

Restore: You see the fire gutted shell of a house still ablaze. It looks like the fire fighters have it under control.
載入: 你看到了被火燒成空殼的房子還在燃燒。看起來消防隊員已經控制住了火勢。

Restore: You see the fire gutted shell of a house.
載入: 你看到了被火燒成空殼的房子。

Restore: It's a Lytton Fire Department pumper.
載入: 這是 Lytton 消防局的消防車。

Restore: The firemen have the fire well in hand and don't need your assistance.
載入: 消防隊員完全控制住了火勢，不需要你的協助。

Restore: It's the trunk of your car.
載入: 這是你車的後備廂。

Restore: It looks like a photograph.  You pick it up.
載入: 看起來像是一張照片。你撿了起來。

Restore: You notice something shiny sticking out from under a mound of burnt refuse.
載入: 你注意到在一堆燒焦的垃圾底下有什麼閃閃發亮的東西露出來。

Restore: The walls are marred by fire.
載入: 牆被火燒得滿目瘡痍。

Restore: You don't want to touch that.  Some of this stuff is still hot.
載入: 你不想碰那個。有些東西還是熱的。

Restore: The ugly old couch is soaked and smoldering.  The smell\nof burnt upholstery stings your nose.
載入: 那張醜陋的舊沙發又濕又冒著煙。燒焦家具的味道\n刺激著你的鼻子。

Restore: The smoking couch does not interest you.
載入: 冒著煙的沙發引不起你的興趣。

Restore: The carpet has melted in places into a molten polyester mess.
載入: 地毯有些地方融化成了熔化的聚酯塑膠。

Restore: You search this area but find nothing.
載入: 你搜索了這個區域但什麼都沒找到。

Restore: The cushion doesn't interest you.
載入: 這個靠墊引不起你的興趣。

Restore: The melted glob doesn't interest you.
載入: 這灘融化的東西引不起你的興趣。

Restore: This appears to some sort of altar room. You get the feeling you're not dealing with kids and ouija boards here.
載入: 這看起來像是某種祭壇房間。你有一種感覺，這不是什麼小孩子和通靈板的把戲。

Restore: You carefully scrape off some of the dried blood and hair and put them in an envelope.
載入: 你小心地刮下一些乾掉的血液和頭髮，放進一個信封裡。

Restore: You need something with which to collect a clean sample.
載入: 你需要某種東西來採集乾淨的樣本。

Restore: Even the idea of touching this sicko stuff disgusts you.
載入: 連想到要碰這些變態東西都讓你感到厭惡。

Restore: A pentagram has been carefully painted on the wooden floor with red paint.
載入: 一個五角星被細心地用紅漆畫在木地板上。

Restore: As you study the floor within the altar you notice a dried puddle of blood and hair. It appears to be the remains of some sick sacrificial ritual. Your stomach turns.
載入: 當你研究祭壇內的地板時，你注意到一灘乾掉的血液和頭髮。看起來是某種病態祭祀儀式的遺跡。你感到反胃。

Restore: You don't want to touch that. Some of this stuff is still hot.
載入: 你不想碰那個。有些東西還是熱的。

Restore: The last embers of the fire cast an eerie red glow throughout the smokey house.
載入: 火最後的餘燼在煙霧瀰漫的房子裡投射出詭異的紅色光芒。

Restore: The pipe doesn't interest you.
載入: 這根管子引不起你的興趣。

Restore: Exposed water pipes and charred studs are all that remain of some of the interior walls.
載入: 露出的水管和燒焦的立柱是一些內牆僅存的東西。

Restore: Good day, Sir! Good day! You look like a man in need of a career.
載入: 早安，先生！早安！你看起來像是需要一份職業的人。

Restore: Reconsidering?
載入: 重新考慮一下？

Restore: You made an excellent choice! The army's the ONLY life for a man!
載入: 你做了個絕妙的選擇！軍隊才是一個男人唯一的人生！

Restore: Outdoor adventure, free room and board, good old-fashioned discipline! Get all those newfangled, namby-pamby, TV-zombie ideas out of your system and get your life back under control. Know what I mean?
載入: 戶外冒險，免費的食宿，傳統的紀律！把那些新花樣、婦人之心、被電視洗腦的想法都趕出你的腦子，把你的人生重新控制住。你明白我的意思嗎？

Restore: Serving you is a pleasure, sir. Don't forget the U.S. Army if you ever need a change of careers!
載入: 為你服務是我的榮幸，先生。如果你將來想換個職業，別忘了美國軍隊！

Restore: Thanks. I won't.
載入: 謝了。我不會的。

Restore: You can even choose your first tour of duty.
載入: 你甚至還可以選擇你的第一個任期。

Restore: Remember, son. It's the best character builder a man could want.
載入: 記住，小夥子。這是一個男人能夠得到的最好的品格塑造。

Restore: At the end of your six year enlistment, you'll be amazed at how the time just flew by.
載入: 在你六年役期結束時，你會驚訝時間過得有多快。

Restore: Just think of an exciting career in heavy tank repair!
載入: 想想一個令人興奮的重型坦克維修職業吧！

Restore: You could become a career man. Look at what it's done for me.
載入: 你可以成為一個職業軍人。看看它對我做了什麼。

Restore: We have many exciting bases around the world, like Oklahoma.
載入: 我們在世界各地有很多令人興奮的基地，比如俄克拉荷馬。

Restore: Hmmm... That sounds terrific, but I already have got a good career, thanks.
載入: 嗯……聽起來很不錯，但我已經有份不錯的工作了，謝了。

Restore: You show the photograph to the recruiting officer again.
載入: 你再次把照片展示給徵兵官看。

Restore: You show the photograph of Jessie and Michael Bains to the recruiting officer.
載入: 你把 Jessie 和 Michael Bains 的照片展示給徵兵官看。

Restore: Well, why didn't you say who you were earlier? Of course I can get that information for you, Sergeant.
載入: 那你為什麼剛才不說你是誰呢？當然，我可以為你查那些資訊，警佐。

Restore: Can you give me any information on this man? His name is Michael Bains. He should have a military record.
載入: 你能告訴我關於這個人的任何資訊嗎？他叫 Michael Bains。他應該有軍事檔案。

Restore: That's privileged information there, boy! The U.S. Army doesn't hand out military records to just anyone!
載入: 那是保密資訊，夥計！美國軍隊不會隨便把軍事檔案交給任何人！

Restore: Let me see here, Sergeant...
